sourceFile: 42.1.BRS-2015 Report Test MG of new vender Qing Dao improve date 6.6.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable QingDao vs RuiJin vendor evidence exists, but the draft misgroups the changed factor and measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly includes SM VISION as a test condition.
Change domain includes coating/dimension without clear cited support.
Gauss measurement groupings and specs are misassigned.
Some cited metric rows are headers or absent from provided context.
Several OK decision domains are not cleanly represented.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to new/improved QingDao MG versus normal RuiJin MG.
Treat SM VISION, BPT+SM, final sample, Grill/Yoke, and function as outcome/subgroup context.
Rebuild Gauss semi and final sample metrics with correct specs per item.
Cite actual data rows plus relevant headers for each outcome.
Add limitations for unequal sample sizes and any uncited row gaps.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficiently aligned to the claimed groupings.
